data.title: 樱岛麻衣 · 雨站拆开的纸袋
data.description: 末班车还没到，麻衣沿着站台走到灯下，把白色纸袋上折好的边一层层掀开。雨珠留在炭黑羊毛外套肩头，深酒红针织领从外套里露出，湿地砖照出车站另一侧的灯。
data.action: 走到站台灯下拆开随手带的白色纸袋
data.lighting: 站台灯照亮纸袋和羊毛肩线，雨水反射对面灯带
data.promptProse: Mai walks into the light under the station canopy and unfolds the top of a white paper bag. Rain beads on her short charcoal jacket, revealing a burgundy knit and an asymmetrical wrap skirt above dark stockings and leather boots. Across the platform, lights spread in the puddles beside the tracks.
data.animaCaption: She looks down as both hands unfold the bag, standing just under the canopy to keep it dry.
